_about: Substance properties for the registry. molarMass kg/mol, cp J/(kg K) by phase, hhv J/kg, density kg/m3 by phase (at the condition in note), melting/boiling point C at 1 atm. null = no standard reference value found; never guessed. Atomic masses for the formula check: IUPAC CIAAW standard atomic weights https://ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm. Not carried over from the pirate table: smoke (soot and tars, no single substance) and the tagged-substance template.
